name: Spend Providers
description: Per cloud/billing provider month-to-date vs last-month spend

agentPrompts.label: Record this month's spend for a provider
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-devops` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then ingest the month-to-date and last-month spend I give you for the named provider through the spend ingestion script — never write billing numbers directly, and never store provider credentials.

agentPrompts.label: Which providers show a spend anomaly?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-devops` skill in this folder, then show me which providers' month-to-date spend is anomalously above last month relative to the configured threshold, with the delta percentage for each.
